CODE
Art. 2.3.34. 
Refusal or inability to express his or her will 
If a spouse refuses to give his or her consent without a legitimate reason or if he or she is unable to express his or her will, his or her spouse may obtain authorisation from the family court to perform alone any of the acts listed in articles 2.3.31, paragraph 2, 2.3.32 and 
2.3.33.
